params.text: DONE: The automation layer is built and verified. The Proxzy POC now has four new pages: Agent Control (rule picker, scenario chips, Live bypass, token injection, session start/end, engine restart, control feed, endpoint contract), API Test Bench (suite editor, method/URL/header/body/inject/scenario fields, header assertion, run-one/run-all through the real loopback proxy via system curl, JSON import/export, WireMock mappings export), Screen Play & MCP (editable engine/device steps, real hit checkpoints, simulated taps clearly marked, iOS/Android/Android-emulator port targets, MCP/Playwright/XCTest/Espresso/Env tabs, play JSON import/export) and the Map Local Connector pipeline (six-stage device→engine→match→scenario→injection→response strip, harness command, match/scenario/injection cards, response preview, tokens, scoped cURL). cargo test: 50 passed, 0 failed. cargo build: succeeds (19 pre-existing warnings). rebuild_check: build passed, app-screenshot passed at 2880×1664, 'This would pass.' Proof shots: app/shots/studio-agent.png, studio-tests.png, studio-tests-run.png (4 mocked API tests passed in 43–78 ms through the real proxy), studio-screen.png, studio-screen-run.png (runner executed engine steps, marked device steps simulated, paused at a hit checkpoint), studio-map-pipeline.png, studio-map-table.png, studio-guide.png. Traps: views.rs, rules_ui.rs and studio_ui.rs are textually included into app.rs, so never add mod declarations for them; studio.rs is a real module in main.rs. Sample Map Local rules stay off by default (map_enabled=false); explicit runs auto-arm, and the Tests page has an Arm engine chip. Screen-play ExpectHit waits for new traffic after the step starts, not cumulative hits. Never touch /Applications/Proxyman.app, build only inside app/, and do not start dev servers or watchers. Open questions about the original Proxyman's exact layout/visuals remain unknowable under clean-room rules. Next move: none required.

params.text: DONE: App-scoped security plan is implemented and verified. Proxzy still defaults to loopback 127.0.0.1; LAN is explicit opt-in (0.0.0.0) with an ephemeral proxzy_<hex> control token saved 0o600. Control plane now requires an exact local Host, no Origin, and loopback peer or constant-time X-Proxzy-Control/Bearer token on GET and POST; control/portal are unreachable through intercepted TLS. Portal serves /, /ca.cer (DER), /ca.pem (PEM), /ssl and proxzy.local with no-store/nosniff. Upstream resolution happens once with an SSRF guard (blocks unspecified/link-local, non-loopback peer to loopback, self-listener bounce) while keeping local dev at 127.0.0.1:3000. read_head has a 10s timeout and the listener caps at 128 connections. Real device setup now offers iOS device plus Android USB reverse (default) and Wi-Fi LAN. UI adds a LAN toggle, LOCAL ONLY/LAN EXPOSED pill, portal/cert copy buttons, masked token copy and transport chips. Verification: cargo build clean (only the workspace-root profile notice, which cannot be changed under the app-only rule), cargo clippy clean, cargo test 54 passed/0 failed, --screenshot draws a non-blank 2880x1668 UI at app/shots/now.png, and rebuild_check says 'This would pass.' Runtime curl checks earlier confirmed loopback health/portal 200, correct CA content types, spoofed Host 403, Origin 403, LAN without token 403 and with token 200, while normal HTTP/HTTPS proxying still works. BLOCKED: root README, scripts/, packages/proxzy-client, CONTEXT.md, ADRs and .gitignore are outside app/ and were not changed. Clean-room unknowns about the original Proxyman's exact visuals/device prompts remain open because reference/ and capture/ have no original screenshots. Traps: views.rs, rules_ui.rs and studio_ui.rs are include!d into app.rs, never add mod declarations; studio.rs is a real module in main.rs; the built binary is target/debug/proxzy, not app/target/debug/proxzy; sample Map Local rules stay off until explicitly armed; never touch /Applications/Proxyman.app and never run networksetup without confirmation. Next move: none required unless the person relaxes the app-only rule for the root-level release items.

params.done_when: A real request proves capture through the gate, the Mac route explains a silent simulator, full HTTPS catch is explicit and safe by default, IDE briefs are copyable, tests pass, screenshots are current, and rebuild_check reports it would pass.
params.purpose: Learning POC for the person: see how a Proxyman-style proxy, mock engine and agent-driven verification fit together, and get simulator traffic visible without unsafe system changes.
params.question: Why does a connected iOS Simulator show no traffic in the Proxzy POC, and how can the app prove capture works while also giving external IDE agents a real hook into the proxy engine?

params.resolution: Answered for the product: system-wide HTTPS is now an explicit opt-in (Full HTTPS catch, or --full-catch), while the safe default keeps a raw tunnel and protected Apple/Google services bypass. The simulator silence was a routing/repaint problem, not a missing interceptor: the check now proves a real request arrives and reads the inherited Mac route, with a confirmed Use Mac proxy action instead of guessing. The original Proxyman's exact setup screen remains unknown under the clean-room rule.

params.text: DONE (this turn): Investigated the 'simulator connected but no traffic' report and fixed the product-side causes. The idle egui window now repaints every 120 ms while the proxy is running, so live requests appear without moving the mouse. HTTP CONNECT is no longer left as a silent raw tunnel when the allowlist is empty: an explicit Full HTTPS catch switch in Live Capture (and --full-catch on the CLI) decrypts every host except protected Apple push/OS/cert and Google Play services, while the default stays selective. Live Capture now has a Capture Check strip that sends a real GET through proxzy.gateway, reports PASS/FAIL, status, ms, HTTPS mode and the inherited Mac route; 'Mac route Direct (off)' is what explains an empty simulator, and the app offers a confirmed Use Mac proxy / Copy fix action instead of changing settings silently. Agent Control gained a Hook an IDE card that copies a plain-text brief for Cursor (.cursor/rules/proxzy.mdc), VS Code (.github/copilot-instructions.md), Claude Code (CLAUDE.md) and JetBrains (.junie/guidelines.md), plus a copyable health command; the brief covers health, scenario, inject, session summary and reset with loopback-only guardrails. README updated for the check, full catch, IDE hook and PROXZY_DEMO=check/doctor/agent-hook. VERIFIED: cargo build clean; cargo test 62 passed / 0 failed (including a new ide_hook_tests brief test); fresh screenshots app/shots/doctor.png (PASS, Mac route Direct (off)), doctor-full.png, cur-*.png, agent-hook.png; rebuild_check says 'This would pass.' Mac Wi-Fi proxy is still read-only confirmed Enabled: No, and no process is listening on 9090 now. Clean-room unknowns about Proxyman's exact visuals/device prompts and GraphQL breakpoint arrangement remain open because reference/ and capture/ have no original screenshots. TRAPS: views.rs, rules_ui.rs and studio_ui.rs are include!d into app.rs, never add mod declarations; studio.rs is a real module in main.rs; binary is target/debug/proxzy; never open /Applications/Proxyman.app and never run networksetup without explicit confirmation. NEXT: none required; if the person wants system-wide capture, press Set Mac proxy / Connect and confirm, then run the check and reload the simulator app.
